d:
Diwali par sasti lauki se banayein Lauki Kalakand — doodh phate bina, lacchedar!
Lauki ka lachha, ek chammach dahi wala doodh — poori ghar ki banayi.
tazi lauki chunna, kaddukas karna aur bache bich ke hisse ka upyog
dudh men ek chammach dahi: bina phate lachchhedar kalakand
milk paudar se bainding aur lauki taiyar hone ki pahchan
do parten, sajavat aur phrij men set karne ka samay
Comment karein — aap Lauki Kalakand kis tyohar par banayenge?
